prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1175; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a rear-end collision in which our client was injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, together with a certified copy of the declarations page and a written statement confirming whether any other coverage, including excess or umbrella coverage, may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, telematics and event data, vehicle repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any communications with your insured or third parties. Destruction or alteration of such materials may result in sanctions.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm the name of the adjuster assigned to this claim. We look forward to your prompt response.
